fusions.name: Thrown From the Seat
fusions.desc: Throws a blade from your seat at the first enemy in its path. It deals 6 damage, with 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been hurt. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Running Cut
fusions.desc: A cut as you pass that deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Edge in the Lap
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 15 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn on the Move
fusions.desc: Each time you have travelled far enough, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
